newsitem.title: USA: Seitel "impact" find to produce this month.
newsitem.headline: Seitel "impact" find to produce this month.

text.p: Seitel Inc said Tuesday one of its new "impact" projects was a successful discovery well that is expected to begin production this month.

Seitel's DDD Energy Inc subsidiary has a 43.5 perecent working interest in the TexStar Petroleum 1 Board of Supervisors 16-3 well, located at Reedy Creek Field in northeastern Jones County, Mississippi.

The well is expected to start commercial sales by the end of May at an initial rate of 600 to 800 barrels of oil plus 450,000 to 600,000 cubic feet of natural gas per day from the Upper and Lower Smackover, Seitel said.

It said flow rates as high as 1,250 barrels of oil and 900 thousand cubic feet of gas per day, on a 12/64-inch choke with flow tubing pressure of 1,750 pounds per square inch, were recorded during an extensive testing period. Test production was from selective perforations between 14,494 and 14,450 feet. Total depth drilled was 15,195 feet and at least 115 feet of net pay was logged in four productive intervals -- the Cotton Valley, Upper and Lower Smackover and Norphlet Formations.
Seitel said an offset well at Reedy Creek is presently drilling and potentially could produce from two zones.

A third well, another potential dual producer, is scheduled to be drilled later this year. Additional Reedy Creek drilling for oil prospects at shallower depths is expected to also start later in the year, following completion of more extensive technical evaluation.

"Reedy Creek, which is one of our new 'impact plays,' could be contributing very material daily production revenues to DDD Energy later this year as a result of our large equity stake in this project," said Horace A. Calvert, Seitel's chief operating officer and DDD Energy's president. Four privately owned companies are DDD'S partners in the Reedy Creek project.
